seo.title: Miti Restaurant & Café Karama | Indian Food, Shisha & Live Music near Park Regis
seo.description: Miti Restaurant & Café, 11th St near Park Regis, Al Karama: modern Indian food, chaat and pani puri, tikka smoked pots, jini dosa and pizza paratha, mocktails, shisha lounge and live music. 4.5 from 1,483 reviews.
